title: BeginUndoGroup Command
description: Open one undo record that collects every change to the active document until end_undo_group, so one Undo reverts them all. Groups do not nest. The plugin ends the group when the client that began it disconnects, when no command arrives for idle_timeout_seconds, and when the document closes or another document becomes active.

name.description: Short name for the change. Rhino lists the undo step as 'MCP: <name>', using the first line, cut to 80 characters.

idle_timeout_seconds.description: End the group when no command from any client arrives for this many seconds.

examples.name: Agent turn: extrude the selected curves
